notes:
OCRelay 1.1.16

NEW: RENAL ARTERY DUPLEX

• Renal US is now one entry in the study list with two studies beneath it: Renal, as before, and the new Renal Artery. Your existing Renal settings are unchanged.

• Fills the aortic PSV; the proximal, mid and distal PSV and renal-aortic ratio on each side; the arcuate resistive index by pole on each side; and kidney size and cortical thickness. Picking up the US RENAL ARTERY template in PS360 selects it automatically.

• Acceleration times are read and shown for checking, but the report has no line for them, so they are not written. The hydronephrosis pick lists, Hemodynamic Flow, Other and the Impression are left for you.

• What the tech writes beside the kidney drawings — stones, cysts, sizes — is shown in a yellow banner so it isn't missed. It is not written to the report; dictate it under Other if it belongs there.

• The worksheet checks itself. Each renal-aortic ratio must equal that velocity divided by the aortic velocity, so a misread digit — 212 read as 72 — contradicts the written ratio and raises a red banner naming the segment before anything is sent.

FIX: A DROPPED VALUE ON A REPEATED LINE COULD BE MISSED

• Some reports print the same line twice, once per side. If the right side's value landed and the left side's identical paste was dropped, the right line was taken as proof of both and the fill reported success with a value missing. Each line is now checked by what its own paste changed, so a dropped twin is caught and retried.
